Welcome toKing's School
At King's School we seek to ensure that all we do is driven by our core value of love. Love necessitates respect for all; a responsible approach to all our actions and interactions; and the demonstration of forgiveness.
GCSE EXAM RESULTS 2026
Many congratulations to the class of 2026 on their wonderful GCSE results! We are delighted for each and every one of them and grateful to the dedicated and hard-working staff who have supported them to reach their potential. We are celebrating another fantastic set of results this year with many individual success stories. Results across the curriculum are exceptionally strong, including in English and Mathematics, and 41% of all grades achieved were 9-7. Well done everyone!
Please read below for a joint statement on GCSE results from all secondary state headteachers in Brighton and Hove:
“Secondary Headteachers across Brighton & Hove are writing jointly to celebrate the achievements of our students and recognise the hard work, determination and resilience that has brought them to this point. As a city, we believe every young person is a City Child, and that every child’s success matters to us all. Today’s results reflect the achievements of individual students and the dedication of the staff, families and communities who support them. We also recognise that every school serves a unique community, with different cohorts of young people bringing their own experiences, strengths and challenges. Results are only one part of the story of a school and the young people within it. Our shared commitment is to celebrate success wherever it is found, learn from one another and continue working together to ensure that every City Child has the opportunity to thrive. We are incredibly proud of all our students, congratulate them on their achievements and wish them every success for the future.”
OFSTED REPORT
King's School was inspected on 19th and 20th May 2026. You can view our Ofsted Report Card here. We are delighted with our report which reflects the student experience in our high performing and inclusive school.
"Pupils thoroughly enjoy their time at King’s. They thrive in this school and are proud to attend."
OPEN EVENTS 2026
Thank you for your interest in a Year 7 place for your child in September 2027. You can find out all the information on our Open Events this year here. We are running the following:
We look forward to welcoming you to King's School this autumn.

About Careers
The Careers Leader at King's is Head of Sixth Form/Assistant Headteacher, Mrs Abi Coles. She can be reached via [email protected] or on 01273 840004.
The vision for our Career programme at King’s is to develop knowledge, skills and character in our students so that they can flourish to make aspirational decisions in their own career journey.
We want the students to develop employability skills and knowledge of available pathways to enable them to make informed decisions following Year 9, Year 11 or Year 13.
King’s career programme incorporates both formal careers education, information, advice and guidance activities, as well as other opportunities linked to each of the students’ subjects, whether this is delivered through bespoke lessons, external speakers, educational visits or developing our staff’s knowledge of the careers and opportunities linked to their subject areas. We use Unifrog as our career platform.
We believe that the whole school staff has a responsibility for the ‘careers education’ of its students and, therefore, it is important that all staff maintain an up-to-date knowledge of the opportunities that relate to their subjects, encourage students to explore ideas and are happy to provide additional information to students, or to refer them to other resources/colleagues with a more specific knowledge.
We evaluate our career programme by using the future skill questionnaire on compass plus with our students. We also use destination data and regular feedback from pupils, parents, teachers and employers to measure the impact of the careers programme.
King's Strategic Career Plan
King's Career Programme 2025-26
For information on our Careers and Employability Policy and our Provider Access Policy, please see our Policies page:
King's School Policies
Gatsby Benchmarks
The careers programme here at King's follows all 8 Gatsby Benchmarks, these are as follows;
1. A stable careers programme2. Learning from career and labour market information3. Addressing the needs of each pupil 4. Linking curriculum learning to careers 5. Encounters with employers and employees 6. Experiences of workplaces 7. Encounters with further and higher education 8. Personal guidance
An updated version of the Gatsby Benchmarks was published in late 2024 as part of Gatsby’s report Good Career Guidance: The Next 10 Years.
